lessons.summary: Durability design, availability, retrieval charges and AZ failure tolerance are different dimensions.

lessons.title: Glacier classes: choose retrieval behavior
lessons.summary: Archive selection must satisfy the time needed to restore usable data, not just the storage price.

lessons.title: Intelligent-Tiering follows changing access
lessons.summary: Intelligent-Tiering optimizes access-tier placement; it does not decide whether an object should exist.

lessons.title: A lifecycle rule follows object age and version
lessons.summary: Model current and noncurrent transitions, expiration and total cost.

lessons.title: Lifecycle rules manage the whole object history
lessons.summary: A lifecycle rule is an automated data-retention decision; test the scope before applying it.

lessons.title: Give a client temporary S3 access
lessons.summary: Authorize a presigned operation for a specific object and limited lifetime.

lessons.title: Presigned URLs delegate a bounded request
lessons.summary: A presigned URL is delegated request authority, not a new public bucket policy.

lessons.title: Deliver static files without public bucket access
lessons.summary: Use CloudFront with Origin Access Control to serve a private S3 origin.

lessons.title: Static assets: servers, shared files or an object origin?
lessons.summary: Add compute and filesystem layers when their semantics are needed, rather than merely to hold unchanged static objects.

lessons.summary: Evaluate public access blocks, policy, identity, ownership and explicit deny.

lessons.summary: Scope ListBucket to a prefix and object actions to matching keys.

lessons.title: Access points separate application permissions
lessons.summary: Give each application a controlled access path while retaining bucket guardrails.

lessons.title: Access points and private network access
lessons.summary: A private network path and permission to access an object are separate controls.

lessons.title: Browser CORS is separate from S3 authorization
lessons.summary: Treat browser preflight rules and S3 request authorization as separate gates.

lessons.title: Default encryption protects new S3 objects
lessons.summary: Understand SSE-S3 defaults and why a new encryption setting is not retroactive.

lessons.title: SSE-KMS needs S3 and KMS authorization
lessons.summary: Check both S3 access and KMS key permissions, including cross-account access.

lessons.title: Encryption: protect data and authorize the key
lessons.summary: Encryption is useful only when authorized applications can use the keys and unauthorized callers cannot.

lessons.title: Replication is not a complete backup
lessons.summary: Use independent recovery controls for accidental deletion and compromised accounts.

lessons.title: S3 replication needs versioned buckets and a role
lessons.summary: Enable versioning at both ends and authorize the replication role.

lessons.title: Replication: same Region or another Region?
lessons.summary: A replicated copy is useful only if its permissions, keys and recovery design survive the intended failure.

lessons.title: Replication timing, existing objects and deletion
lessons.summary: Asynchronous replication has a recovery-point implication and is not a substitute for independent retention.

lessons.title: Existing objects need a separate replication path
lessons.summary: Use Batch Replication for existing objects and understand delete-marker handling.

lessons.title: Choose recovery controls for the actual failure
lessons.summary: Test the full restore path; the existence of another copy does not prove a usable recovery.

lessons.title: Multi-Region Access Points: global entry and regional data
lessons.summary: Global request routing and regional object replication are separate mechanisms.

lessons.title: Multipart upload isolates and retries parts
lessons.summary: Parallelize large uploads, retry failed parts and complete or abort the upload.

lessons.title: Multipart upload: parallelize and retry parts
lessons.summary: Multipart upload is a managed transfer lifecycle, not just several simultaneous PUT requests.

lessons.title: Incomplete multipart uploads still consume storage
lessons.summary: Successful cleanup requires the right lifecycle action, not merely deleting an object key.

lessons.title: Byte-range GET: fetch only the needed bytes
lessons.summary: Less transferred data helps only when the application understands and correctly assembles the selected bytes.

lessons.title: Scale requests across useful key prefixes
lessons.summary: High S3 capacity does not guarantee that the client, encryption path or network can keep up.

lessons.title: Choose the transfer path for distant clients
lessons.summary: Evaluate direct regional transfer against acceleration for distant clients.

lessons.title: Transfer Acceleration helps distant uploads
lessons.summary: Acceleration optimizes the journey to a bucket; it is not multi-Region object replication.

lessons.title: Events trigger work without coupling upload and processing
lessons.summary: Route object events to asynchronous workers and handle duplicates.

lessons.title: S3 event notifications: react without coupling
lessons.summary: An object event is a signal to process; it is not exactly-once execution.

lessons.title: EventBridge adds richer event routing
lessons.summary: Richer routing does not remove duplication, permissions or downstream failure handling.

lessons.title: Observe who accessed an S3 object
lessons.summary: Choose CloudTrail data events, server access logs and metrics for the evidence needed.

lessons.title: S3 evidence: access logs, data events and metrics
lessons.summary: Choose evidence by the question: which API, which request, or what aggregate trend?

lessons.title: Inventory and Storage Lens answer different questions
lessons.summary: Distinguish object-level Inventory reports from aggregate Storage Lens insights.

lessons.title: Storage Class Analysis informs lifecycle decisions
lessons.summary: A recommendation informs the decision; a lifecycle rule performs the transition.

lessons.title: Storage Lens: see storage across the organization
lessons.summary: Aggregated visibility helps locate problems; it does not apply the corrective policy by itself.

lessons.title: Use S3 Batch Operations for existing objects
lessons.summary: Operate on existing objects in bulk with a manifest and completion report.

lessons.title: Build an object-metadata index for application queries
lessons.summary: An application index must be maintained and repaired; object storage does not make that workflow atomic.

lessons.title: Keep static delivery separate from dynamic processing
lessons.summary: Each layer should own one responsibility: delivery, computation, metadata lookup or durable object storage.

lessons.title: Choose the S3 protection and transfer design
lessons.summary: Select protection, replication, transfer and observability by the failure model.

lessons.title: S3 architecture decisions: fit the access and failure model
lessons.summary: A strong S3 design balances access, security, recovery, performance and cost across the whole application.
